purpose: Defines test principles, the mapping from requirements to designs and verification points, cross-cutting scenarios, and approval status for verifying the doc-link design.
summary: Test norms: state-machine transitions in DES-004 are the sole allowed transitions; guard failures and unlisted events are rejected
Missing reference targets do not block candidate finalization; interruption, rerun, and multi-key isolation are tested
check-impact tests: writes nothing, compares recorded content hash with current hash, repeats until recorded, no notification chain
check-links tests: reports inline links with DLID titles, reads records only in the recorded-word form
Deterministic processing gets separate unit tests: target expansion, parsing, ID handling, path resolution, completion result assembly
Requirement-to-design-to-verification mapping table covering FR and NFR items
Cross-cutting scenarios: first build, move, content change, failure, multiple keys, out-of-range references, later references
Approval status: all open requirement items are decided and the design is reviewed and approved
tasks: Writing tests for state transitions and deterministic processing
title: DES-009 要件対応と設計検証
